resources.name: actor_record_pointer_table_88E4_00_05.bin
resources.purpose: actor record base pointers selected by F1 packet byte 5 bits 2-4

resources.name: motion_pointer_table_A1B4_00_71.bin
resources.purpose: motion script roots selected by F1 packet byte 1; bounded through animation $8F's maximum index $71

resources.name: appearance_pointer_table_AC47_00_93.bin
resources.purpose: appearance script roots selected by F1 packet byte 2; bounded through animation $8F's maximum index $93

behavior: select record index (selector & $1C) >> 2 and resolve $88E4 pointer
resolve motion index through $A1B4 and appearance index through $AC47
store pointers at actor record offsets +$01 and +$03
copy packet coordinate bytes to actor record offsets +$08 and +$0C
store active byte $80 | (selector & $03) at actor record offset +$00
